Why launch a rocket every time you need to move cargo to orbit? The §6Space Elevator§f gives you one-way transport between a planet's surface and a deployed space station.

Vanilla crafting recipe: Control Circuit Board, Advanced Circuits, structure machine, and aluminum coils. The structure is a 3x3 column of coilAluminum extending straight up 64 blocks to a platform in orbit. Right-click each coil block with a Wrench to bind it to the controller.

You need a §6Space Elevator Chip§f (Tracking Circuit + Advanced Circuit + Data Unit in the Precision Assembler) to designate the destination. Right-click the controller to teleport, 10 second ride, takes your inventory with you. Costs 1000 RF per trip.

§cWARNING:§f The coil column must be perfectly straight. Any deviation breaks the multiblock. Build it before placing the controller.
